Bylaw No. 14853 
Page 1 of 3 
 
 
CITY OF BURNABY 
 
 
BYLAW NO. 14853 
 
 
A BYLAW to close and remove the dedication of  
a certain portion of highway 
 
 
WHEREAS pursuant to section 40 of the Community Charter and section 120 of the Land 
Title Act, Council may by bylaw close part of a highway to traffic and remove the dedication 
of that part of the highway; 
 
AND WHEREAS Council, before adopting this Bylaw, has caused the required statutory 
public notice of its intention to be given by advertisement; 
 
AND WHEREAS Council deems it expedient and in the public interest to stop up and close 
to traffic and remove the dedication of that portion of highway more particularly hereinafter 
described, 
 
NOW THEREFORE the Council of the City of Burnaby ENACTS as follows: 
 
1. 
This Bylaw may be cited as BURNABY HIGHWAY CLOSURE BYLAW  
NO. 1, 2026. 
 
2. 
ALL AND SINGULAR those certain parcels or tracts of land, situate, lying and 
being in the City of Burnaby, in the Province of British Columbia, more particularly 
known and described as that portion of road dedicated by Plan 3347 in  
District Lot 125, Group 1, New Westminster District containing 113.5m2  as shown 
outlined in bold on Reference Plan EPP155233 (hereinafter called “the closed 
portion of road”), prepared by Liming Yuan, B.C.L.S, a copy of which is hereunto 
annexed, is hereby closed to all types of traffic. 
 
 

Bylaw No. 14853 
Page 2 of 3 
 
 
3. 
The dedication of the closed portion of road as highway is removed. 
 
Read a first time this 27th day of October, 2026 
 
Read a second time this 27th day of October, 2026 
 
Read a third time this 27th day of October, 2026 
 
Public Notice Dates this 5th day of November, 2026, and 12th day of November, 2026 
 
 
Reconsidered and adopted this 24th day of November, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
MAYOR 
 
 
 
Signed Original Bylaw on file. 
 
DEPUTY CORPORATE OFFICER 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Bylaw No. 14853 
Page 3 of 3 
 
 
Schedule “A”

minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby closes 113.5 m² of road near District Lot 125 and removes its highway status
minutes_briefs.summary: Burnaby City Council has adopted Bylaw No. 14853, which closes a small strip of road (about 113.5 square metres) to all traffic and removes its legal status as a public highway. The land is part of a road dedicated by Plan 3347 in District Lot 125, Group 1, New Westminster District, and is shown on Reference Plan EPP155233. The bylaw was adopted on November 24, 2026, after public notice was given on November 5 and 12, 2026. Once a road's dedication is removed, the land is no longer public road and can be sold or used for another purpose.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check whether your business property, access, parking, or deliveries touch this closed road section and confirm with the City of Burnaby how access will be affected.
